name: You Don't Know Jack
summary: The tabletop version of "You Don't Know Jack" was released by Tiger Electronics and operates off of four AA batteries. It offers a streamlined gameplay experience with just the basic question format (no Gibberish questions) and only 10 questions per game with values of $1,000, $2,000 or $3,000 with no Jack Attack. Hosted by Nate Shapiro (game creator Harry Gottlieb), the game serves as a scorekeeper of dollar values won or lost. Includes 125 question cards with 500 total general knowledge questions. At least two expansions were released a TV Pack and a Movies Pack each adding 113 cards with 450 (TV) or 452 (Movies) additional questions in the set's given subject.
